blocks.value: When you buy shares, you need a safe place to store them. Just like money is stored in a bank account, shares are stored in a Demat Account.
Imagine This: You buy a gold necklace. Instead of carrying it everywhere, you keep it safely in a bank locker. A Demat Account works like a digital locker for your shares.
Demat stands for Dematerialized Account. Instead of receiving paper share certificates, your ownership is stored electronically.
If you buy 10 shares of Infosys today, they will appear in your Demat Account once the transaction is completed.
You own the shares in your Demat Account even if you change your stock broker later.
